what: GLOBAL mean-blend recenter, LIFT-ONLY. The q50 head is MAE-optimal but, for the right-skewed/zero-inflated WAR label, sits below the expected value - so the displayed point projection read systematically LOW for every player (forward-chained + holdout bias ~ -0.15 WAR at all horizons; the owner-reported 'a bit low across the board'). shift = lambda_h * (implied_mean - q50); q50' = q50 + max(0, shift). implied_mean = trapezoid of the five quantile heads. LIFT-ONLY: under-projected (right-skewed) rows recenter UP; a projection is NEVER pulled down - a symmetric recenter trimmed ceiling stars (mean < median when the downside tail dominates), contradicting the intent; the q90 band already carries that downside. Bands untouched; coverage/pinball preserved. Self-scaling: high-skew profiles lift more than flat replacement rows.
protocol: forward-chained dev bases 2017-2021 (per base B the heads train on labels <= B-1); per-horizon lambda grid [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0]; objective minimize |pooled bias| with guard pooled MAE +0.01 max; CONFIRMED on the 2022-2024 holdout (the star h2 blend that FAILED this same holdout was the cautionary precedent). Live regeneration lifts year-1 vet WAR +0.12 on average (918/1246 up), 5y total +0.28; no player lowered.

holdout_2022_2024.note: LIFT-ONLY mode. h5 (and h4 from base 2024) omitted where labels have not matured; n per horizon. Blended model still beats champion marcel_decay_v2 on MAE at h1 (0.559 vs 0.618) while taking the central bias from -0.123 to nearly zero.

disclosed_residual: The recenter only PARTIALLY closes the gap because the model's own quantile heads are tail-light (predict ~25-35% of actual >=3-WAR seasons), so even the implied mean trails the true mean. Fuller correction is a heads-level refit (monotone tail / higher upper quantile) - a separate workstream, not this post-hoc recenter.
